enter.description: Return recorded state with explicit workstream scope. Use a small positive recent window for orientation, not proof of absence; read exact latest_working_note.source and relevant evidence. next_action is closeout-first recorded history, not execution authority. For synthesis, Topic maps and historical-version recovery consult using-aitp/references/research-memory.md; finding a record or its old bytes does not validate its science. Detailed transports are in using-aitp/references/cli-contracts.md. Reuse fresh reports; preserve session/save verification. Ordinary follow-up questions are not new session boundaries; do not repeat enter automatically at every turn end. For current gaps, follow keyword hits with relevant later records in their explicit workstream; without later coverage, qualify the answer as of the record rather than asserting a gap still exists.

parameters.name: recent
parameters.description: Number of recent active entries to project (default 20; must be positive).

parameters.name: workstream
parameters.description: Optional workstream slug to scope the projection.

list.description: List canonical AITP ledger entries with optional kind, recorded-time, and workstream filters. Superseded entries remain visible. Use aitp_show for one complete entry and grep over .aitp/topic/ for full-text search.

parameters.name: kind
parameters.description: Only entries of this durable-event kind.

parameters.name: since
parameters.description: Only entries recorded at or after this ISO date/timestamp (inclusive).

parameters.name: workstream
parameters.description: Only entries explicitly in this workstream.

show.description: Open one exact AITP ledger entry by ID and return its complete frontmatter and body. When native AITP read tools are available, prefer them over duplicate CLI calls; the Hakimi plugin Skill instructions own native-versus-CLI routing and exact launcher resolution.

parameters.name: entry_id
parameters.description: Exact entry ID (for example entry-<32 hex>.md basename without .md).

check.description: Validate the whole store read-only: exit 0 clean, 1 findings, 2 cannot run. Scoped output still scans globally. For multi-line read-only recovery, use one global check with scoped enter reads; never relabel the global report as scoped. Reuse a complete matching report only over a known-unchanged work interval; ledger, policy, evidence changes or uncertain freshness require refresh. Always check after save. Empty scoped clean does not certify the whole store. Findings affecting evidence relied on require investigation; unrelated findings do not block independent research. Exit 2 does not establish verified memory. Details: using-aitp/SKILL.md and using-aitp/references/cli-contracts.md.

parameters.name: workstream
parameters.description: Scope findings to records that explicitly list this workstream.

exit_codes.2: AITPError JSON envelope or argparse misuse

backfill workstreams.description: Reviewed explicit workstream backfill for legacy AITP records. Dry-run by default. Requires a mapping JSON file and a human decision Entry whose refs sha256-pin the mapping. Apply only adds/merges frontmatter workstreams and never infers membership.

parameters.name: mapping
parameters.description: Workspace-contained mapping file (schema aitp/backfill-workstreams-0.1).

parameters.name: decision
parameters.description: Human decision Entry ID that sha256-pins the mapping file.

parameters.name: apply
parameters.description: Write the reviewed backfill; without this flag the command is dry-run only.

record prepare.description: Prepare a new AITP durable-event Entry draft. The result is a draft path only: read the draft, replace every template prompt with real content, then call aitp_record_save. Kinds: observation, result, failure, decision, source, code_change, run, closeout. Use authority "agent" for agent-authored records; created_by is required for agent authority.

parameters.name: kind
parameters.description: One durable-event kind; choose exactly one per event.

parameters.name: authority
parameters.description: Recording authority (default "agent").

parameters.name: created_by
parameters.description: Provenance id (required when authority is "agent"); use agent:<name> or tool:<name>.

parameters.name: idempotency_key
parameters.description: Optional retry key; reusing it avoids duplicate drafts for the same logical write.

parameters.name: workstreams
parameters.description: Optional workstream slugs assigned to this entry.

record save.description: Validate and save a filled Entry draft into the canonical ledger. AITP does not require a Research Action or checkpoint. For scoped compare-and-save, including direct records and checkpoint-bound records, pass both expected_topic and exact_workstream so the current Topic and exact singleton membership are compared under the write lock before canonical save. No durable change requires no new record.

parameters.name: draft
parameters.description: Draft path returned by aitp_record_prepare (for example .aitp/local/drafts/entry-<id>.md).

parameters.name: expected_topic
parameters.description: Expected current Topic slug. Must be passed together with exact_workstream.

parameters.name: exact_workstream
parameters.description: Require the Entry workstreams value to be exactly this singleton slug. Must be passed together with expected_topic.

exit_codes.2: AITPError JSON envelope, including invalid or failed compare-and-save preconditions

note prepare.description: Prepare a new AITP Note draft (working or theory). The result is a draft path only: read the draft, fill every section and pinned basis_refs, then call aitp_note_save. Use a working Note for a requested or genuinely changed synthesis, not every result or tool call. Retain a detailed argument in a theory Note or one primary ordinary manuscript; do not automatically duplicate report, Entry, Note and card. Interpretation can narrow while the underlying calculation remains valid; explain this in the body. Examples: using-aitp/references/research-memory.md.

parameters.name: mode
parameters.description: working or theory note mode.

parameters.name: title
parameters.description: Short note title.

parameters.name: created_by
parameters.description: Provenance id; use agent:<name> for agent-authored notes.

parameters.name: workstreams
parameters.description: Optional workstream slugs assigned to this note.

note save.description: Validate and save a prepared Note. For a captured singleton scope pass both expected_topic and exact_workstream; Topic and exact draft membership are checked under the write lock before validation, write and retries. Read using-aitp/references/recording.md before writing, and using-aitp/references/research-memory.md for synthesis. A provisional plan may cite an attributed unverified proposal; no results does not mean no source refs. After draft repairs keep summary, prose and refs consistent. Preserve scientific limits; verify with check/enter after save; no duplicate result just to announce a Note. Old adapters without contract-0.3 support must not silently fall back to unscoped save.

parameters.name: draft
parameters.description: Draft path returned by aitp_note_prepare (for example .aitp/local/drafts/note-<id>.md).

parameters.name: expected_topic
parameters.description: Expected current Topic slug. Must be passed together with exact_workstream.

parameters.name: exact_workstream
parameters.description: Require exactly this singleton Note workstream. Must be passed together with expected_topic.

operator_only.reason: blank-tree creation is a human operator decision
legacy bootstrap writes an inventory file and is operator-only

sync_rule: This file is the machine-readable adapter surface. AITP CLI, transport-schema, or Skill-surface changes must update it in the same change; consumers may fail closed when its sha256 or version is unknown. Skill routing distinguishes marker discovery from relevant distillation review; historical markers alone do not trigger full review during ordinary read-only recall. Ordinary recall adds no standalone hash audit; required new pins may reuse verified same-target unchanged digests, without weakening save/check validation.
